meta.title: Piano to MIDI: turn a piano recording into MIDI
meta.description: Upload a piano recording and get an editable MIDI file with notes, dynamics and pedal. Tune the transcription by hand or let it pick the settings.

app.tagline: Turn a piano recording into MIDI you can edit.
app.lead: Notes, dynamics and sustain pedal, ready for your DAW. Adjust the transcription to the piece, or let it choose the settings.

footer.privacy: Recordings are processed and deleted; nothing is kept.

upload.formats: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG
upload.limits: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG, up to {mb} MB and {minutes} minutes

errors.not_audio: That doesn't look like an audio file. Try MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG.
errors.too_long: The recording is longer than {minutes} minutes.
errors.empty: The recording is empty or too short.
errors.busy: Too many recordings are waiting. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.expired: This transcription no longer exists: they're deleted an hour after the last visit.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.

job.waiting: {n} recording ahead of yours… | {n} recordings ahead of yours…

result.kept: Kept for an hour after your last visit, then deleted automatically.

roll.label: Piano roll: {notes} notes over {time}
roll.legend: A stronger colour means the note was played harder. The lane below shows the sustain pedal.
roll.legendHands: Blue: right hand, orange: left hand. A stronger colour means a harder note.

auto.noisy: Noisy recording: the quietest moments are only {db} dB below the loudest.
auto.sensitivityKept: Sensitivity left as it is: no other setting explained the sound better.
auto.raised: Sensitivity raised: {n} doubtful note left out, as it didn't match the sound. | Sensitivity raised: {n} doubtful notes left out, as they didn't match the sound.
auto.lowered: Sensitivity lowered: {n} quiet note kept, as it matches the sound. | Sensitivity lowered: {n} quiet notes kept, as they match the sound.
auto.steady: Steady rhythm at about {bpm} BPM: the MIDI follows that tempo and notes are pulled towards a {grid} grid.
auto.free: Free timing (around {bpm} BPM on average): kept as played, as a grid would distort it.
auto.fewNotes: Too few notes to judge the rhythm: timing kept as played.
auto.split: Two hands heard: right hand from {key}, on separate tracks.
auto.together: One track: the notes don't form two separate hands.

player.noOriginal: The recording is only kept in the tab you uploaded it from.
player.midiNote: MIDI is played by a simple built-in synthesizer, to check notes and timing; in a DAW it will sound like your chosen piano.
